scoring_justification: Cannot fully recompute the FE simulation results within the verifier; instead compare reported fracture summary values to paper-reported experimental data (T0) and cross-consistency checks with load-displacement curve (T3).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference for crack initiation location, fracture mode, punch travel at first fracture, and peak force from paper Fig.16 experimental data for square punch case 1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.16 and text: punch travel at first fracture ~14.2 mm, peak load ~85 kN.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read from paper description; values hardcoded as approximate experimental observations.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported experimental measurements for the same case.

outputs.description: Summary of predicted fracture characteristics: crack initiation location, fracture mode, punch travel at first fracture, and peak punch force.
Load‑displacement curve sampled from the simulation, used to verify the qualitative shape (monotonic increase, sharp drop at fracture) and consistency with the summary peak force.

steps.description: Check monotonicity, peak consistency with summary, and sharp drop after fracture.
